calls.statement:
SELECT product_key, sku, product_name, valid_from, valid_to
FROM dim_product
WHERE subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
  AND valid_from <= '2026-08-02'
  AND valid_to >= '2026-06-29'
ORDER BY product_key

SELECT SUM(quantity) as total_units
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE store_key = 13
  AND sale_date >= '2026-06-29'
  AND sale_date <= '2026-08-02'
  AND product_key IN (
    SELECT product_key
    FROM dim_product
    WHERE subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
      AND valid_from <= '2026-08-02'
      AND valid_to >= '2026-06-29'
  )

SELECT sale_date, COUNT(*) as line_count, SUM(quantity) as units
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE store_key = 13
  AND sale_date >= '2026-06-29'
  AND sale_date <= '2026-08-02'
  AND product_key IN (
    SELECT product_key
    FROM dim_product
    WHERE subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
      AND valid_from <= '2026-08-02'
      AND valid_to >= '2026-06-29'
  )
GROUP BY sale_date
ORDER BY sale_date

SELECT 
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  'FY2026/27' as fiscal_year,
  3 as fiscal_period,
  SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE s.store_id = 108
  AND f.sale_date >= '2026-06-29'
  AND f.sale_date <= '2026-08-02'
  AND p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
  AND p.valid_from <= '2026-08-02'
  AND p.valid_to >= '2026-06-29'
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name
